title: Audit + outline: Tactus-web Model/Agent docs
description: Audit ../Tactus-web for Model + Agent primitive documentation and examples; record what needs updating; propose an outline/writing notes aligned to the canonical narrative in Tactus docs.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_close_reason: Audit complete: recorded findings + outline/writing notes
custom.beads_notes:
Findings (2026-02-14):
- Tactus-web already has a dedicated model primitive page: src/pages/model-primitive.js with Option A syntax (Model.training) + CLI (tactus train --model, tactus models evaluate).
- static/llms.txt includes the same unified Model.training narrative + commands.
- src/data/examples.json includes CI-safe mocked examples AND real trainable examples (IMDB Naive Bayes + HF sequence classifier) with branching logic + deterministic specs.

Potential follow-ups:
- Re-scan the rest of the site for any stale Model/Agent snippets (result.response/message, Agent.toolsets, provider required) and normalize.
- Ensure install guidance is consistent: ML extras are optional (tactus[ml], tactus[hf]) and pip install tactus should not pull datasets/torch by default.

Outline / writing notes (proposed):
- Add/confirm a short 'Agent vs Model' framing section on the site (either in both pages or a shared glossary page):
  - Agent = deliberation + tools + conversation; Model = prediction only.
- Model primitive page (src/pages/model-primitive.js):
  - Keep Option A as the only syntax shown; add a one-paragraph explanation of what persists (artifact + metrics + tags) and what does not (no hidden state).
  - Add a callout: training requires optional extras; base install does not include datasets/torch.
  - Add a 'Mock-first workflow' block: tactus test --mock, then tactus train, then tactus test (real).
- Examples gallery (src/data/examples.json):
  - Ensure every trainable model example includes 4 commands: test mocked, train, evaluate, test real.
  - Ensure mocked specs test branching logic (yes/no/review) rather than only 'procedure completes'.
- llms.txt: keep canonical patterns minimal but correct; ensure no stale keys (toolsets, result.response).
